exit_plan.note: 2029 exit plan: at least half the portfolio moves into income funds. Miner net yield on 2029 value is ~3.7% (after ~16.15% NR301 withholding on the THX CAD dividend, not reclaimable in ISA/SIPP), so any fund yield above that raises income while shedding single-name and pre-production risk. Terminal value dominates: bear-bull swings 2029 income by ~GBP 64k vs ~GBP 8k across the whole transfer/yield grid. Edit transfer_share (0-1) and fund_yield (0-1) to re-plan.

actions.body: EPC terms agreed (Nov-26), conditional on convention approval - construction can start on award. Convention is now the sole milestone before FID; median Q1-27. Optimised PFS + updated MRE due year-end; minority buyout still needs ministerial approval. Producer FY26 guidance cut to 70-72koz (rainfall). Hold; no top-up until the convention is signed.

First gold slipped Dec-26 to Q1-27 (cabling stolen in transit); construction ~75%. Capex US$171m to US$186m. Sep-26 cash US$31.8m gross includes the fully drawn US$27m equipment loan (net ~US$5m); pre-pay part-used; 'fully funded' wording softened. Fatality 19 Oct, works resumed. Current mine extended to end-Jan 27. Funding risk re-opened - an equity raise is an entry opportunity, not a thesis break. Freeze rotation trigger on any share-count change.
